title: 第500章 骸骨高地的情报第499章 亡灵魔法
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 林鬼对骸骨高地的了解并不多。
他只知道那里是亡灵魔法的产物，是几年前那场差点覆灭千塔之都的狂潮留下的禁地。
至于具体的穿越路线、恶魔分布、危险层级，他一概不清楚。
当初在枯木荒原，艾尔维亚和艾琳提到埃什利家族时顺带说起过那件事，但只是寥寥几句带过。
所以他抵达白杨堡的时候，特意去购置了一本禁地大全。
然后他发现，骸骨高地的危险程度，在禁地里属于垫底的存在。
准确来说，它甚至够不上禁地的标准。
那些曾经掀起亡灵狂潮的传奇级和史诗级骸骨。
早在那场大战中就被千塔的法师们清理干净了。
剩下的都是一些余兵，零零散散地游荡在荒芜的高地上，构不成太大威胁。
如今的骸骨高地，连黄金冒险者都能通过。
骸骨高地，虽然是禁地。
但只是名义上有些传奇色彩，实际上，危险程度非常低。
所以林鬼根本就没有打算过多关注。
其实在枯木荒原的时候，林鬼就判断过这一点。
艾尔维亚提起那次亡灵狂潮时说过。
整个高地的骸骨倾巢而出，都没能覆灭千塔。
一个正常的禁地，如果出动全部力量，靠恶魔的数量和质量都能堆死千塔。
像是枯木荒原，黑水森林，这些禁地垫底存在，都能做到。
结果骸骨高地并没有覆灭千塔。
那就说明这个禁地比吊车尾，还要吊车尾。
可偏偏就是这样一片日渐衰弱、威胁度持续走低的区域，系统给他刷出了一个亡灵魔法。
哪怕这个魔法本身非常鸡肋，派不上什么用场，林鬼的心还是突突直跳。
他太了解系统的套路了。
那些没有在明面上写明危险的委托，总能在途中给他当头一棒。
护送克罗蒂娜的路上被影刃琳逮到，差点被杀。
枯木荒原看似简单的货物运输，最终牵扯出半魔和千塔的斗争，还把大贤者给引了出来。
他当时给自己的巨大压迫，至今让他心有余悸。
这次虽然只是抽到了一个亡灵魔法，但这种巧合总让他不安。
林鬼走出邮局，挂上信件放邮箱后，便开始打听骸骨高地的情报。
在接下来的几天里，他通过各种渠道来打听消息。
学者公会出版的禁地相关书籍。
里面记录着官方的勘察数据和风险评估，可信度最高。
他也在绿荫廷的冒险者公会里搭了几句话。
找到几个在骸骨高地活跃过的老练冒险者。
还有一些本地居民，偶尔会穿过那片区域来往于附近的城邦。
content_en:
Lin Kuei didn't know much about the Skeleton Highlands.
He only knew that it was the product of undead magic, a forbidden area left behind by the craze that almost destroyed the Capital of Thousand Towers a few years ago.
As for the specific crossing route, the distribution of demons, and the level of danger, he has no idea at all.
Back in Deadwood Wasteland, Alvia and Irene mentioned that incident in passing when they mentioned the Ashley family, but they only mentioned it in a few words.
So when he arrived at Baiyang Castle, he went out to buy a complete encyclopedia of forbidden lands.
Then he discovered that the danger level of Skeleton Highland was at the bottom among the forbidden areas.
To be precise, it doesn't even meet the standards of a forbidden area.
Those legendary and epic skeletons that once set off the undead craze.
It had been cleared away by the mages of Thousand Towers as early as that battle.
The rest are some remnants, wandering scatteredly on the desolate highlands, posing no great threat.
Today's Skeleton Highlands can be passed even by golden adventurers.
The Bone Plateau is a forbidden area.
But it's only legendary in name. In fact, the level of danger is very low.
So Lin Gui didn't intend to pay too much attention at all.
In fact, Lin Gui had judged this point when he was in the Deadwood Wasteland.
Alvia said this when she mentioned the undead craze.
Skeletons from the entire highland poured out, but failed to destroy the Thousand Towers.
In a normal forbidden area, if all the power is deployed, the number and quality of demons can kill a thousand towers.
Such as Deadwood Wasteland, Black Water Forest, these bottom-level forbidden areas can do it.
As a result, the Skeleton Highlands did not destroy Thousand Towers.
That means that this forbidden area is more than the tail end of the crane.
But it happened that in such an area that was gradually weakening and the threat level continued to decrease, the system cast an undead magic for him.
Even though the magic itself was very useless and of no use, Lin Gui's heart was still beating fast.
He knows the rules of the system too well.
Those commissions that didn't clearly indicate the danger would always give him a blow in the head on the way.
On the way to escort Claudina, she was caught by Shadow Blade Lin and almost killed.
The seemingly simple transportation of goods in the Deadwood Wasteland eventually involved a struggle between the half-demon and the Thousand Towers, and even led the great sage out.
The huge pressure he put on himself at that time still makes him feel lingering fear.
Although he only drew an undead magic this time, this coincidence always made him uneasy.
Lin Gui walked out of the post office, hung up the letters and put them in the mailbox, and then began to inquire about information about Skeleton Highlands.
In the next few days, he sought information through various channels.
Books related to forbidden areas published by the Scholars Guild.
Official survey data and risk assessments are recorded in it, which is the most credible.
He also had a few words with the Adventurer's Guild in the Green Palace.
Find several experienced adventurers who have been active in the Bone Highlands.
There are also some local residents who occasionally pass through that area to travel to nearby city-states.
